current.text: He signed with Miami as the replacement for Norman Powell.
Miami's projected starting five is Mitchell, Thompson, Wiggins, Giannis and Bam, so Klay Thompson holds the wing spot Hardaway competes for.
The expert rates him better than Klay Thompson this season, but expects Klay may still get ceremonial minutes, which cuts into Hardaway's role.
The expert is not very interested in him and calls ESPN's rank of 156 too high.
With the March 28 end date, Miami plays a weak 4-3-3 schedule in our fantasy playoff weeks, 10 games in total, and has no back-to-backs in those weeks.
Miami has the league-minimum 13 back-to-backs this season.

durable.text: He is a threes-only player. He makes close to three threes a game but adds almost no steals or assists and little rebounding.
His free throw shooting is good, but his field goal percentage is bad.
He is a volume three-point shooter who fires right away off passes.
His defense is bad, though he gives good effort.

note: Both sites put his value at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 193, ESPN rank 155). The expert says even ESPN's rank is too high, and 144 players get drafted in our league, so he is not a draft target. He is a possible waiver add for threes. He makes about 2.5 threes a game, and his low turnovers and good FT% help a little, but his FG% hurts and he adds little else. Early in the season, check whether he takes starter minutes from Klay Thompson. Also note that Miami has only 10 games in our playoff weeks.
